{{Youmay|the facility on [[Jardeen IV]]|the [[Imperial Army Training Center]] on [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]]}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] maintained a '''training center''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jardeen IV]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arndall Lott]] was in charge of [[Walker Operations and Tactics]] at the center, and the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Reliance (Star Destroyer)|''Reliance'']], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Iolan Gendarr]], guarded the facility. The pair evacuated the facility following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to create their own [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] faction.
